youtube.title: usb drive says file too large? it's FAT32, not space #shorts
youtube.description:
FAT32 can't hold a single file of 4GB or more, even on an empty drive. check the format in Properties (Windows) or Disk Utility (Mac), back up, then use exFAT if the device that reads it supports it.
